hero.title: Projects that deliver. Organizations that evolve.
hero.subtitle: I set up project offices, lead complex deliveries, and develop project managers ready for the real world.

services.title: Services
services.subtitle: Tailored solutions for each stage of your organization's project management maturity.

s1.title: PMO Setup & Structuring
s1.description: I build and organize project offices from scratch. From diagnosis to operation, I create methodologies, rituals, artifacts, and governance aligned with your company's context and culture.

s2.title: PMO & Project Management
s2.description: I take over the management of strategic projects as a dedicated PMO or PM. I deliver structure, visibility, and results — without you needing to build an internal team from scratch.

s3.title: PM Development
s3.description: For those who already know the theory and need real practice. Workshops and mentoring focused on everyday situations: tough conversations, decisions under pressure, team leadership, and political navigation.

about.title: About me
about.p1: I'm Renato Decker, a project manager with over a decade of experience in complex, multicultural, and high-pressure environments.
about.p2: I have worked with strategic PMO, digital transformation projects, mergers, and international expansion. My approach combines methodological rigor with pragmatism: what matters is the result, not the certificate on the wall.
about.p3: I believe project management is, above all, about people. Methodology is a tool, not an end.

hero.subtitle: PMO · Project Management · Portfolio · Team Leadership

summary.title: About
summary.p1: Over 20 years of career in IT, focused on project management, portfolio, and PMO. Entire career at Agrosys Tecnologia, a national reference company in Technology Services for Agribusiness.
summary.p2: Expertise across the full project management cycle: planning, scope control, scheduling, SLA, risk management, and stakeholder alignment. Specialist in building methodologies and high-performance teams.
summary.p3: Experience leading teams of up to 20 people, conflict management, continuous improvement, and process governance — always focused on results, not bureaucracy.

r1.title: Implementation Manager
r1.desc: Responsible for the Implementation area, managing a team of 6 project managers and 20+ employees. Structuring methodology, processes, and governance for ERP project deliveries. Portfolio control, KPIs, and SLA management.

r2.title: Product Manager
r2.desc: Led a team of 14 analysts and developers. Implemented agile methods, product roadmap and backlog management. Strategic alignment between business and technology areas, portfolio prioritization, and delivery management.

r3.title: Software Development Portfolio Manager
r3.desc: Managed the software development project portfolio. Supported the project managers team, removed obstacles, ensured strategic alignment and applied PMBOK standards. Risk control and executive reporting.

r4.title: Support & Service Manager
r4.desc: Managed level-1 support (6 people) and level-2 support (14 people). Defined and controlled SLAs, implemented quality KPIs, escalation processes, and continuous improvement initiatives.
